episodes.title: One Box Left
episodes.description: The hunters corner the Count in London, but he slips away.

scenes.narration: Last time, the Count attacked Mina and bound her to him.
scenes.visual: Mina sitting on a bed, staring blankly, Jonathan holding her hand

scenes.narration: Van Helsing touches Mina's forehead with the holy bread.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing touching a white wafer to Mina's forehead

scenes.narration: It burns her, leaving a red scar.
scenes.visual: A red burn mark on Mina's forehead, her eyes closed in pain

scenes.narration: The hunters race across London, destroying box after box.
scenes.visual: Men in a horse-drawn cab racing through foggy London streets

scenes.narration: In a house in Piccadilly, they wait for the Count to return.
scenes.visual: Men waiting in a dark Victorian room, weapons ready

scenes.narration: He bursts in, and Jonathan slashes at him with a great curved knife.
scenes.visual: Jonathan swinging a curved knife at the cloaked Count

scenes.narration: The blade cuts his coat, and gold coins pour out.
scenes.visual: Gold coins spilling from a slashed coat onto the floorboards

scenes.narration: The Count leaps through the window into the courtyard below.
scenes.visual: The Count leaping through a window in a burst of glass

scenes.narration: My revenge has only begun, he sneers.
scenes.visual: The Count looking up from a courtyard, sneering

scenes.narration: And one box of earth is still missing.
scenes.visual: A single wooden crate on a dark London dock

episodes.title: Through His Eyes
episodes.description: Mina turns the Count's curse against him.

scenes.narration: Last time, the Count escaped, with one box still missing.
scenes.visual: A dark London dock at dawn, an empty space where a crate stood

scenes.narration: Mina has an idea. The Count's bite connects her to him.
scenes.visual: Mina sitting upright, determined, the red scar on her forehead

scenes.narration: She asks Van Helsing to hypnotise her at dawn.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing hypnotising Mina by candlelight, moving his hands before her eyes

scenes.narration: In a trance, she senses what the Count senses.
scenes.visual: Mina in a trance, eyes glazed, faint red light around her

scenes.narration: All is dark. She hears water lapping and chains creaking.
scenes.visual: Darkness inside a ship's hold, water dripping, heavy chains swaying

scenes.narration: The Count is on a ship, running home to his castle.
scenes.visual: A sailing ship gliding down a river at dawn

scenes.narration: The ship is the Czarina Catherine, bound for Varna on the Black Sea.
scenes.visual: An old map of Europe with a route traced to the Black Sea

scenes.narration: The hunters pack their weapons for one last journey.
scenes.visual: Weapons, crucifixes and travel cases on a table by lamplight

scenes.narration: They will follow him to the ends of the earth.
scenes.visual: The group standing together at a railway platform in fog

scenes.narration: Because if the Count dies, Mina's curse dies with him.
scenes.visual: Mina touching the scar on her forehead, looking out at the dawn

episodes.title: The Race East
episodes.description: The hunters chase the Count across Europe, but he always seems to know their plans.

scenes.narration: Last time, Mina's trance revealed the Count sailing home.
scenes.visual: A ship on a dark sea under a crescent moon

scenes.narration: The hunters cross Europe by train to meet his ship in Varna.
scenes.visual: A steam train racing through Eastern European countryside

scenes.narration: They wait for days, but the ship never arrives.
scenes.visual: Men waiting on a misty harbour quay

scenes.narration: It slips into a different port, Galatz, instead.
scenes.visual: A ship docking at a river port at night

scenes.narration: The Count may be reading their plans through Mina's mind.
scenes.visual: The Count's shadowy face looming over Mina as she sleeps

scenes.narration: By the time they reach Galatz, his box is gone, carried upriver.
scenes.visual: An empty dock with drag marks where a crate was taken, a river beyond

scenes.narration: The hunters split up.
scenes.visual: The group separating at a muddy crossroads

scenes.narration: Jonathan and Arthur chase by steam launch up the river.
scenes.visual: Two men on a small steam launch racing up a wide river

scenes.narration: Seward and Quincey ride along the banks on horseback.
scenes.visual: Two riders galloping along a riverbank

scenes.narration: Van Helsing takes Mina by carriage, straight to the castle.
scenes.visual: A carriage driving through the snowy Carpathian mountains

scenes.narration: And Mina is changing. She sleeps nearly all day now.
scenes.visual: Mina asleep in a carriage, very pale

episodes.title: The Circle in the Snow
episodes.description: Van Helsing protects Mina from the three sisters, then enters the castle alone.

scenes.narration: Last time, the hunters split up to chase the Count home.
scenes.visual: Riders and a carriage spread across a snowy valley

scenes.narration: Near the castle, Van Helsing makes camp in the snow.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing and Mina at a campfire in snowy mountains, a castle in the distance

scenes.narration: He draws a circle around Mina with crumbs of holy bread.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing scattering white crumbs in a circle around Mina in the snow

scenes.narration: At midnight, three figures form out of the swirling snow.
scenes.visual: Three pale women forming out of swirling snow at night

scenes.narration: The Count's three women call to Mina, as if she were their sister.
scenes.visual: Three pale women beckoning with outstretched arms, smiling

scenes.narration: Mina cannot leave the circle. And they cannot enter it.
scenes.visual: Mina inside a faintly glowing circle in the snow, the women outside it

scenes.narration: At dawn, Van Helsing enters the castle alone.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing walking through a ruined castle gate at sunrise

scenes.narration: He finds the three women asleep in their tombs, and ends them one by one.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing standing over a stone tomb in a dark chapel, hammer in hand

scenes.narration: Then he seals the Count's empty tomb.
scenes.visual: A large empty stone tomb being sealed in a dark chapel

scenes.narration: Far below, a wagon races up the mountain road carrying a single box.
scenes.visual: A horse wagon racing up a snowy mountain road carrying a large crate

episodes.title: Sunset
episodes.description: The hunters' last chance to stop the Count before the sun goes down.

scenes.narration: Last time, the Count's box raced toward the castle.
scenes.visual: A wagon on a snowy mountain road at sunset

scenes.narration: The sun is setting. If it sets before they reach him, the Count will wake.
scenes.visual: A red sun sinking behind snowy peaks, a wagon racing below

scenes.narration: The hunters charge the wagon from every side.
scenes.visual: Riders galloping through snow toward a wagon surrounded by men

scenes.narration: Jonathan and Quincey fight their way through to the box.
scenes.visual: Jonathan and Quincey forcing their way through a crowd of men around a wagon

scenes.narration: Quincey is wounded, but he will not stop.
scenes.visual: Quincey clutching his side, blood on his coat, still pushing forward

scenes.narration: They throw the lid off. The Count's red eyes open in triumph.
scenes.visual: The Count lying in a box of earth, red eyes snapping open in the sunset glow

scenes.narration: Jonathan's knife slashes his throat. Quincey's blade pierces his heart.
scenes.visual: Two blades striking down into a box, silhouetted against the setting sun

scenes.narration: The Count crumbles into dust, with a look of peace.
scenes.visual: A figure crumbling into dust that drifts away in red sunset light

scenes.narration: The scar fades from Mina's forehead.
scenes.visual: Mina's clear forehead, tears of joy, golden sunset light

scenes.narration: Quincey dies smiling, knowing they have won.
scenes.visual: Quincey lying in the snow smiling, friends kneeling around him

scenes.narration: Years later, Jonathan and Mina name their son Quincey.
scenes.visual: Jonathan and Mina with a small boy in a sunny English garden
